title: Restricted Entropic and Quadratic Hedging in the Small-Risk-Aversion Limit
abstract: arXiv:2610.12594v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In incomplete markets, contingent claims cannot in general be replicated exactly, and hedging must therefore be formulated as an optimization problem over admissible trading strategies. This paper studies the relation between quadratic hedging and entropic hedging in a discrete-time incomplete market when strategies are restricted to bounded finite-dimensional parametric classes. These restrictions induce admissible gain sets that are compact and convex in \(L^2\), providing a common well-posed setting for both the restricted mean-square hedging problem and the restricted exponential-utility hedging problem. The main contribution is to establish a uniform small-risk-aversion expansion of the entropic risk functional over the restricted gain set and to use this uniformity to obtain convergence of the corresponding minimizers. translated_title: 小风险厌恶极限下的受限熵对冲与二次对冲
translated_abstract: 在不完全市场中，未定权益通常无法被精确复制，因此对冲问题必须表述为在可容许交易策略上的优化问题。本文研究了离散时间不完全市场中二次对冲与熵对冲之间的关系，其中策略被限制为有界的有限维参数类。这些限制所诱导的可容许增益集在 L² 中是紧致且凸的，从而为受限均方对冲问题和受限指数效用对冲问题提供了一个共同的适定框架。本文的主要贡献是建立了熵风险泛函在受限增益集上的一致小风险厌恶展开，并利用这种一致性得到相应极小化子的收敛性。在一处一致指数可积性假设下，受限熵对冲增益在 L² 中收敛到……（摘要原文至此处截断）
tldr: 本文在受限策略框架下建立了熵风险泛函的一致小风险厌恶展开，证明受限熵对冲增益在 L² 中收敛，从而在风险厌恶趋近于零的极限下将熵对冲与二次对冲联系起来。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a uniform small-risk-aversion expansion of the entropic risk functional over compact convex restricted gain sets, proving L² convergence of restricted entropic hedging gains and thereby linking entropic and quadratic hedging in the small-risk-aversion limit.
